name: BBQ Pulled Pork Stuffed Peppers

fit.note: 426 cal in 400-650 band; 7g carbs well under 35g; no seafood; scalable to 14 (shred a butt, mix, stuff, bake). FIT.

dupe_evidence: Not a duplicate. Every pulled-pork recipe in the 118-item pork catalog rides a STARCH base or bowl (bbq-pulled-pork-stuffed-sweet-potatoes, pulled-pork-baked-mac-and-cheese, pulled-pork-enchilada-bake, pulled-pork-shepherds-pie, pulled-pork-tamale-pie-cornbread, slow-cooker-pulled-pork-bowl, dr-pepper/root-beer bowls); none is a low-carb bell-pepper vessel. The only stuffed-pepper in play, philly-cheesesteak-stuffed-peppers (accepted this run), is BEEF + cheesesteak, not pork + BBQ.
nearest_neighbor: bbq-pulled-pork-stuffed-sweet-potatoes (catalog): shares protein (pulled pork) + sauce (BBQ) + stuffed-and-baked method = 3 of 4 axes. Distinguished only by vessel/carb profile — starchy sweet potato vs low-carb bell pepper with a melted gouda/cheddar cap. Given this run explicitly hunts low-carb, the vessel swap makes a genuinely different plate, so KEEP, but flagging so the decider can make the final call if it wants the catalog to carry only one 'BBQ pulled pork stuffed X'.
cross_protein_collision: Structurally a stuffed-pepper bake. Watch for same-dish-different-protein twins in other selectors' pools: a ground-beef/turkey BBQ or buffalo stuffed pepper, or a chicken stuffed pepper. Already colliding on format (not dish) with the accepted beef philly-cheesesteak-stuffed-peppers.
